data.title: 莉雅丝 · 纯血恶魔破灭之翼
data.description: 【莉雅丝 · 纯血恶魔破灭之翼】旧校舍顶端破碎的红月夜空之下，莉雅丝悬浮半空展开两柄深邃漆黑的恶魔蝠翼。鲜红如血的及膝长发在狂暴魔力气流中肆意翻涌，足尖悬空，掌心凝聚起吉蒙里一族毁灭之力的深红魔法阵——「只要有我在，没有任何人能动我的眷属分毫。」
data.location: 驹王学园旧校舍钟楼顶层夜空
data.action: 展开漆黑恶魔双翼悬浮于夜空，掌心凝聚深红吉蒙里魔力阵，眼眸冷冽威严凝视前方
data.lighting: 猩红月光与掌心魔力光晕交织
data.camera: cowboy shot, low angle, dynamic framing
data.promptProse: Hovering gracefully against a dramatic crimson moonlit night sky, Rias Gremory unleashes her noble devil heritage with enormous dark bat wings outstretched. Her vivid red hair whips dynamically in turbulent magical currents as a glowing crimson Gremory seal revolves in her raised palm. Medium cowboy shot, vibrant anime key visual style, no text, no extra characters.
